evidence: TiCl4 and H2O precursors were alternatively introduced into the chamber through time-controlled solenoid valves. An ALD cycle with eight steps and 1 s per step was adopted for this experiment. The eight steps were TiCl4 reactant, pump down, Ar purge, pump down, H2O reactant, pump down, Ar purge, and pump down. The process pressures were around 40 Pa in deposition and 27 Pa in pump-down steps.
